subject: Pilot supplier onboarding + temporary PO exemption request
messages:
From: Alex Rodriguez <alex@novometer.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-ops@novometer.com
Date: 2028-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding for pilot + temporary PO exemption request

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to kick off a 6-week pilot. We're ready to provide the onboarding forms and an initial invoice, but our procurement at Novometer needs a short-term path: they can issue an invoice-only payment this quarter but won't be able to raise a formal PO until their new ERP goes live in July.

Request: can Redwood accept an "invoice-only" route for the pilot (net30) while we work through PO setup? We can share the completed onboarding form and a signed SOW. If helpful, I attached the onboarding form and a preliminary invoice stub.

High level: Pilot scope = 50k tokens/month, single workspace, data residency unchanged.

Let me know what evidence you need and whether we should route to procurement or finance.

— Alex
Alex Rodriguez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novometer, Inc.
+1 415-555-0198

From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@novometer.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding for pilot + temporary PO exemption request

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. I’ve looped in Marissa (on commercial ops) and Markus (finance) to confirm what evidence we need for a temporary invoice-only path.

Quick ask for us: can you confirm the billing contact, legal signatory on the SOW, and whether Novometer will accept our standard pilot terms? That speeds review.

We’ll aim to provide an interim approval path if risk is low; if finance needs extra controls we may ask for a payment assurance (card on file or prepayment).

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Supplier onboarding for pilot + temporary PO exemption request

Chloe — quick notes from procurement side:

- We can allow a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots <= $30k total spend with basic controls (signed SOW, completed onboarding form, evidence of billing contact).
- Anything between $30k–$75k requires either prepayment or finance sign-off on a PO-exemption waiver.
- For >$75k we won't make an exception without director-level approval and SLA/cancellation clauses tightened.

Looks like Novometer's request (estimated $50k over the pilot) sits in the waiver band. I'll need a completed onboarding checklist and the SOW with signatory details. If Chloe confirms the contact and scope, I can prepare the waiver packet for Markus to authorize.

Marissa Cole
Senior Commercial Ops Manager

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, chloe_martin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-04T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding for pilot + temporary PO exemption request

Thanks — I reviewed Novometer's onboarding form (attached to Alex's email) and the pilot SOW. Two quick conditions for approval of a temporary invoice-only path for the $50k pilot:

1) Novometer signs the SOW and confirms a billing contact and expected invoice schedule (we prefer single invoice upfront or monthly invoices under net30).
2) Novometer agrees to Redwood's pilot termination clause: 7-day notice, reimburse usage through termination date.

If both are satisfied, I will approve a one-time PO-exception waiver and route to payments to accept invoices without an internal PO for this contract period. Please push the checklist back to me once Chloe confirms.

-Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations

From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@novometer.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding for pilot + temporary PO exemption request

Alex — good news. Finance has agreed to a one-time PO-exception waiver for the pilot with two conditions (see Markus below). Please confirm both items so we can get you in the system and accept the first invoice:

1) Signed SOW with Novometer signatory listed and billing contact included.
2) Confirmation you accept Redwood's pilot termination clause (7-day notice, usage reimbursement through termination).

I attached the procurement checklist that Marissa mentioned. If you can return the completed form and the signed SOW by EOD Thursday, I’ll trigger the waiver and onboarding.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachments: procurement_checklist.xlsx
